title: Quasinormal modes and quantum black hole interiors
summary: Quasinormal modes (QNMs) of black hole perturbations in the large overtone limit, namely, asymptotic QNMs, are highly sensitive to a black hole's interior geometry. We probe the singularity structure of a class of exact (2+1)-dimensional quantum black hole solutions to semi-classical gravity by computing their asymptotic QNM spectra. We do this using methods of complex analysis in which the radial coordinate is analytically continued to the complex plane.
